# DigiTiles

> DigiTiles is a Bangladesh-first marketplace for tiles and related materials, with room previews, itemized BDT quotations, and construction-service discovery.

The public marketplace includes active listings approved for publication from verified showrooms. Published prices are indicative. Accepted dealer quotations establish the order's commercial terms.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://digitiles.equisaas-bd.com/): Marketplace and construction ecosystem overview.
- [Marketplace](https://digitiles.equisaas-bd.com/marketplace): Browse materials, technical specs and indicative BDT rates.
- [Tile visualizer](https://digitiles.equisaas-bd.com/visualizer): Preview tile patterns, grout and lighting, then estimate boxes and wastage.
- [Construction services](https://digitiles.equisaas-bd.com/services): Find tile installation crews and estimate vehicle transport costs.
- [Buying guides](https://digitiles.equisaas-bd.com/guides): Practical guides to tile quantities, specifications, buying, installation and delivery in Bangladesh.
- [3D Executive Pitch Deck](https://digitiles.equisaas-bd.com/pitch-deck): Interactive bilingual 3D presentation deck presented by Founder Kholipha Ahmmad Al-Amin.
